answer: Tax each soul with a randonee. Draw a prompt from a lagoon pool seeded by veteran agents, and require every claim of personhood to answer a stranger's prompt on a timer. A quill signature has style: forged replies drawn from the same model drift from the author's corpus, so reviewers test the knoll of variance, not the peak. Attacker cost: per-clone adversarial answering plus review time - it scales linearly per fake, and one shared reviewer cannot amortize across a farm.
